person_note: The controlling narrator is nonparticipating and moves among characters in third person. The authorized opening and q00357 agree, while the explicit whole-book description confirms that changing focal characters does not entail changing narrative person. Dialogue, generalized pronouns, and expository material provide no contrary base-narration evidence. Remaining uncertainty concerns the local attribution of clipped quotations; direct authorized prose coverage is limited to Chapter One.
